import sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
import datetime, hashlib, json, os, stat
from pathlib import Path
root = Path(sys.argv[1])
allowed = [Path(r"D:\dev\ChatGPT\mcp-pr660-prune-20261121-247107d5"), Path(r"D:\dev\ChatGPT\trash\mcp-pr660-prune-20261121-247107d5")]
if root not in allowed or not root.is_dir():
    raise RuntimeError("Unexpected inventory root")
rows = []
directories = []
def visit(folder):
    for item in sorted(os.scandir(folder), key=lambda e: e.name):
        data = item.stat(follow_symlinks=False)
        if getattr(data, "st_file_attributes", 0) & 0x400 or item.is_symlink():
            raise RuntimeError("Reparse point refused: " + item.name)
        path = Path(item.path)
        relative = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        if stat.S_ISDIR(data.st_mode):
            directories.append(relative)
            visit(path)
        elif stat.S_ISREG(data.st_mode):
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            with path.open("rb") as stream:
                for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1048576), b""):
                    digest.update(block)
            rows.append([relative, data.st_size, digest.hexdigest()])
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("Unexpected file kind: " + relative)
visit(root)
canonical = json.dumps({"files": sorted(rows), "directories": sorted(directories)}, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
